summary: Verified /import Paste tab image-OCR upgrade + operator-guide flash decks. All 5 import tabs render with correct data-testids. Paste tab shows new screenshot/OCR copy. Text paste flow still works — extracted 3 entries from sample vintage-log text (Tank 7 Shiraz Brix/pH/DAP). IMAGE PASTE FLOW works end-to-end: dispatching a ClipboardEvent with a fetched placehold.co PNG onto paste-textarea triggered onPaste handler, prevented default text insertion, showed paste-ocr-running indicator, then rendered paste-ocr-result card after LLM round-trip (~30s). Score reads '5 / 5 words recognised' with confidence '100%' (green). Preview image, corrections list, toggle-raw and reset buttons all wired. Textarea auto-populated with cleaned text. Discard clears the card + textarea. All 4 flash-card decks (crm-flash, pipeline-flash, compliance-flash, import-flash) render on /admin/operator-guide and deck-filter pills successfully change the visible cards.
critical_code_review_comments: Import.tsx is 2186 lines — consider extracting PasteTab, CameraTab, VoiceTab, CsvTab, BulkTab into their own files for maintainability.
In ocrImageToCleanText router, the fetch to Emergent LLM has no explicit timeout — a hanging vision call could pin a request; consider AbortController with a 60s cap.

The rawOcrText vs cleanedText toggle produced identical output on the clean placeholder image (expected). Recommend adding a subtle 'no corrections needed' hint when corrections.length === 0 so the toggle button doesn't feel inert to users.
test_credentials: Dev bypass active (seed-owner-001). Gate password middx99 accepted on preview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Paste OCR feature confirmed working with a 5-word test image (placehold.co). For richer validation with real corrections, use a handwritten-notes image with misspellings (e.g. 'shrza Br?x') so the corrections[] array populates and raw vs cleaned differ visibly. LLM round-trip ~15-30s on preview; wait_for_selector timeout 90s is safe. Flash cards on /admin/operator-guide all render and filter correctly.
